notes.title: Revengers Steam Page Announcement
notes.content:
Dear Revengers!

We are more than thrilled to announce our game Revengers, that has been in development for almost a year. We are entering Early Access and it's more than a duty for us to ship you the best co-op game possible! Of course this journey we are willing to take will have it's ups and downs and we really hope we will be together throughout the whole duration. 

[h2]What can you expect?[/h2]
[h3]Devblogs [/h3]
We will inform you about the what's next and what you can expect in the game by releasing regular devblogs here on Steam. We want to keep the continuity and always bring you new content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42974886/a61afb11727e7d2f1827b86067b01b66d88242bb.png[/img]

[h3]Playtests, demos, betas[/h3]
We want to ship the best game possible but that won't be poissible without proper testing, so apart from our own testing, you will be able to join and test the game with us.

[h3]Community[/h3]
We are building a big community around the game and you will be able to join and chat with your friends, devs and other players. Also we will be doing giveaways and you might get special content from the game, that won't be even posted on Steam, or information way more early.

[h3]Screenshots and fun content[/h3]
We are humans after all, so expect funny bugs screenshots, videos and gifs. We love memes! You can meme us as much as you want and the best memes will be highlighted!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42974886/9ade29bc1ac955ff3407dc5a85f12302929938a7.png[/img]

[h3]New updates[/h3]
From the begining, we will be updating the game on a regular basis, also with devblogs and announcements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42974886/4d8c850bbfc395f16caf882f08fdfcf62489df99.png[/img]

That was it for this announcement guys. Looking forward to hearing from you soon! Don't worry, there's more to come in the future. See ya in next updates!

We are here to answer all your questions, so feel free to do so here in comments, or on our discord.

Martin,
Leveland Studios Team

[url=https://discord.gg/uXjV5dmHZd][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42974886/4bbe8d6e1629e371cb7b3097db826b4f3889e8dd.png[/img][/url]
